sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('3f1c3083-91d1-488c-ad07-b198fda21da6', '8eae6b6c-1851-4342-b320-7e1896894658') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
